event_summary.short: Police officers in Salt Lake City were investigated for misconduct after a recruit was directed to pop blisters on a deceased homeless man's body with a box cutter. Officers made disrespectful comments and omitted details from reports. Three officers faced disciplinary action, one resigned, no criminal charges.
